name: Reconstruction Flow Registry
purpose: Define bounded flow classes describing how reconstruction accessibility changes under projection transformations.

flow_classes.definition: Flows where reconstruction accessibility remains constant or improves within bounded limits.
Flows where accessibility metadata begins to decouple from the local neighborhood.
Flows that are arrested at neighborhood boundaries by irreducible projection tensions.
Flows where projection distortion propagates and amplifies across the sequence.
Flows resulting in the gradual loss of all meaningful reconstruction metadata.
Flows where the reconstruction link is broken due to excessive deformation.

metrics.definition: Measures the persistence of the source-relation trace along a dynamic flow.
The rate of change of accessibility quality across the flow sequence.
Measures the loss of projection-domain distinctions during the flow.
Evaluates if conflicts are preserved or erased in the stabilized state of the flow.

governance_rules.rule: Every reconstruction flow must declare its stability class and trace retention score.
Flows with RF_DEFORMATION_CASCADE status trigger mandatory drift detection review.

forbidden_claims: Stable flows prove physical conservation of information.
Flow gradients derive physical time evolution operators.
Accessibility decay justifies the assumption of external detachment.
